entries.title: Psalms 136:1
segments:
PSALM CXXXVI. 
 
  We must praise God as great and good in himself, ver. 1-3.   As the Creator of the world, ver. 4-9.   As Israel's God, ver. 10-22.   As our Redeemer, ver. 23, 24.   As God over all, ver. 25, 26.

entries.title: Psalms 136:2
segments: V. 2. The God of gods-Who is infinitely superior to all that are called gods, whether angels, or princes, or idols.

entries.title: Psalms 136:22
segments: V. 22. Israel-He speaks of all that people as of one man, because they were united together in one body in the worship of God.

entries.title: Psalms 136:25
segments: V. 25. Food-To all living creatures. For which God deserves great praises, which the psalmist teaches us to render to God for them, because those who are most concerned, either cannot, or do not perform this duty.
